home.title: Welcome to {{name}}
home.description: Plan your Instagram feed before it goes live: arrange, sort by colour, group into albums and schedule posts.

specimen.h2: Arrange it before it goes live
specimen.h3: Sort by colour in one action
specimen.h4: Group several images into an album
specimen.paragraph: Drop in a batch of images, drag them into the grid and see how the profile will look before anything is posted. Every change can be undone, and the board stays in your browser.
specimen.small: There are no accounts, and images stay on your device until you schedule them.
specimen.quote: Plan the feed first. Post it when it looks right.
